description: This file defines a data structure and related functions for managing device authentication tokens, including loading, storing, and clearing tokens, with persistent storage in a JSON file.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStoreFile
classes.description: A private struct representing the stored device authentication data, including version, device ID, and tokens.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a device authentication token for a given device ID and role if available.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a device authentication token for a specified device ID and role.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token associated with a specific device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from the role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace and removes duplicates from the scopes array, returning a sorted array.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for the device auth storage JSON file.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the device auth JSON file into a DeviceAuthStoreFile object.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the DeviceAuthStoreFile object to the JSON file, creating directories if needed.
